key: Dare you carry such wretched diplomacy into these holy chambers?!
en: Dare you carry such wretched diplomacy into these holy chambers?!
ja: この聖なる部屋に、そのような忌まわしき外交を持ち込もうというのか?!

key: You, stranger-- that is a DOME Fossil! Be gone at once! Remove your heresy from our sight!
en: You, stranger-- that is a DOME Fossil! Be gone at once! Remove your heresy from our sight!
ja: そこな者よ――それは甲羅のカセキではないか!ただちに立ち去れ!その異端を我らの目の前から消し去るのだ!

key: Start9 start9 start9 start9 start9 start9!!!
en: Start9 start9 start9 start9 start9 start9!!!

key: Ah, welcome, brethren.
en: Ah, welcome, brethren.
ja: ああ、ようこそ、同胞よ。

key: I am glad to invite one such as us-- followers of the Helix.
en: I am glad to invite one such as us-- followers of the Helix.
ja: 我らと同じ者――ヘリックスの信徒を迎えられてうれしく思う。

key: May your Helix Fossil guide you in all times of darkness.
en: May your Helix Fossil guide you in all times of darkness.
ja: なんじのかいのカセキが、あらゆる闇の時にもなんじを導かんことを。

key: Incidentally, we have something we must ask of you:
en: Incidentally, we have something we must ask of you:
ja: ところで、なんじに頼まねばならぬことがある。

key: up anarchy b anarchy anarchy right b democracy anarchy up up anarchy start right up b anarchy anarchy
en: up anarchy b anarchy anarchy right b democracy anarchy up up anarchy start right up b anarchy anarchy

key: I-- excuse me, I don't know what came over me. As I was trying to say...
en: I-- excuse me, I don't know what came over me. As I was trying to say...
ja: 私は――失礼、何が起きたのか自分でも分からぬ。言いかけていたことだが……

key: You have been a good friend to us. You shall always be welcome here so long as you walk the path of the Helix.
en: You have been a good friend to us. You shall always be welcome here so long as you walk the path of the Helix.
ja: なんじはよき友であった。ヘリックスの道を歩む限り、なんじはいつでもここで歓迎されよう。

key: But on that note, might you offer to us your fragment of the divine?
en: But on that note, might you offer to us your fragment of the divine?
ja: だがそれはそれとして、なんじの持つ神の欠片を、我らに差し出してはくれぬか?

key: If you need either of the fossils we have offered you already again, we will be happy to accept Lord Helix in return.
en: If you need either of the fossils we have offered you already again, we will be happy to accept Lord Helix in return.
ja: すでに授けた化石のいずれかが再び必要になった時は、主ヘリックスを引き換えにいただけると喜ばしい。

key: And which inferior fossil should you like?
en: And which inferior fossil should you like?
ja: して、どちらの劣った化石をお望みか?

key: I understand, friend. I would not part from our God either.
en: I understand, friend. I would not part from our God either.
ja: 分かる、友よ。私とて我らが神から離れたくはないだろう。

key: It is yours, friend. Come again whenever you have need of the Helix's guidance.
en: It is yours, friend. Come again whenever you have need of the Helix's guidance.
ja: それはなんじのものだ、友よ。ヘリックスの導きが必要な時は、いつでもまた来るがいい。

key: Our current goal is to seek... Pidgeot, the one true Bird Jesus!
en: Our current goal is to seek... Pidgeot, the one true Bird Jesus!
ja: 我らが今の目標は……唯一真なる「鳥のイエス」、ピジョットを探すことだ!

key: Find him for us, and we shall reward you.
en: Find him for us, and we shall reward you.
ja: 彼を我らのために見つけてくれれば、報いを与えよう。

key: Alas! Bird Jesus has returned to us! Our holy savior... Give him to us now!
en: Alas! Bird Jesus has returned to us! Our holy savior...  Give him to us now!
ja: おお!鳥のイエスが我らのもとへ戻ってきた!我らが聖なる救世主……今すぐ我らに引き渡すのだ!

key: Bird Jesus shall save us all!
en: Bird Jesus shall save us all!
ja: 鳥のイエスが我ら皆を救うであろう!

key: Thank you, brethren. As a token of our gratitude, please accept one of these inferior fossils. Which should you prefer?
en: Thank you, brethren. As a token of our gratitude, please accept one of these inferior fossils. Which should you prefer?
ja: 感謝する、同胞よ。感謝の印として、これらの劣った化石のひとつを受け取ってくれ。どちらがよいか?

key: b down democracy start anarchy right start anarchy
en: b down democracy start anarchy right start anarchy

key: Our current goal is to seek... the Farfetch'd, the Slayer of Trees!
en: Our current goal is to seek... the Farfetch'd, the Slayer of Trees!
ja: 我らが今の目標は……「木々の虐殺者」、カモネギを探すことだ!

key: Fetch him for us, and we shall reward you.
en: Fetch him for us, and we shall reward you.
ja: 彼を我らのために連れてきてくれれば、報いを与えよう。

key: Dux! The faithful slayer! You will give him back to us, yes?
en: Dux! The faithful slayer! You will give him back to us, yes?
ja: ダックスよ!忠実なる虐殺者よ!我らに返してくれるのだろう?

key: So the Helix Fossil was right again... Dux has returned!
en: So the Helix Fossil was right again... Dux has returned!
ja: やはりかいのカセキは正しかった……ダックスが戻ってきた!

key: start anarchy anarchy anarchy anarchy a down anarchy left down start
en: start anarchy anarchy anarchy anarchy a down anarchy left down start

key: Welcome, friend, to the heart of anarchy.
en: Welcome, friend, to the heart of anarchy.
ja: ようこそ、友よ、無政府の中心地へ。

key: Welcome, stranger, to the heart of anarchy.
en: Welcome, stranger, to the heart of anarchy.
ja: ようこそ、見知らぬ者よ、無政府の中心地へ。

key: Tell me, have you accepted Bird Jesus as your personal savior?
en: Tell me, have you accepted Bird Jesus as your personal savior?
ja: 教えてくれ、なんじは鳥のイエスを、なんじ自身の救世主として受け入れたか?

key: Only by establishing a relationship with the true God, the almighty Helix Fossil, can one find salvation in the darkness.
en: Only by establishing a relationship with the true God, the almighty Helix Fossil, can one find salvation in the darkness.
ja: 真なる神、全能なるかいのカセキとのきずなを結んでこそ、人は闇の中に救いを見出せるのだ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Sail Fossil
en: Sail Fossil
ja: ヒレのカセキ

key: Jaw Fossil
en: Jaw Fossil
ja: アゴのカセキ
